status: Scoped Chrome session-retirement persistence accepted locally; live relay/web-tab, whole-wallet lifecycle and final release gates remain open.
behavior: Both WalletConnect roles load the validated, versioned retirement journal before granting SDK session authority. Queued read-transform-write merges topics and preserves unknown record fields. A failed read or malformed record refuses initialization and preserves existing storage.

Disconnect/delete/expire immediately veto the topic in both running services and invalidate captured revisions. Explicit disconnect waits for durable retirement; SDK transport failure after successful local retirement is logged separately. Fresh service instances refuse SDK sessions whose topic is persisted as retired.

Mobile cancellation with a known session waits for retirement storage, shares pending work and retains failed attempts for explicit retry. Late approvals after cancellation retire their new session; existing/imported sessions remain protected. The pairing screen waits before leaving, offers an error and close retry on failure, and ignores late success.

Account removal waits for retirement before forgetting keys/public records. Incoming removal inspects every approved account in base/scoped namespaces, matches standalone primary EVM identity and linked EVM identity, and includes locally retired SDK records so failed writes can be retried. Incoming connection retries initialization even when SDK data already exists.

retirementTests.scope: Actual services and removal handlers with controlled SDK records and actual BaseExtensionStore callbacks. Includes deferred/failed writes, read/corruption refusal, retry, cross-role invalidation, concurrent topic merging, late cancellation and fresh-service reconstruction.

chrome.scope: Actual compiled trusted mobile-create/remove and incoming-disconnect handlers; real Chrome storage in a disposable offline profile; two observed worker target replacements and idempotent retry. Retained SDK authority is not injected into this browser scenario.

finding.issue: removeSessions originally compared EIP-155 namespace identities only to optional linked ethereumAddress. Removing a supported standalone native EVM account lacking that metadata could acknowledge removal without retiring its incoming sessions.
finding.reproduction: Parent preserved session-retirement-standalone-before-v1.log/json: both actual removeSessions(primaryEvm) and actual Extension.accountsForget native pair cases failed at appc7f96e30.
finding.disposition: 728ce546 matches a valid primary EVM identity as well as linked EVM metadata; two regressions exercise durable retirement and reconstruction. Independently read the fix and tests; no remaining scoped blocker.

reviewedBehavior: Shared versioned retirement record validates shape/topics, preserves unknown record fields, merges topics in queued read-transform-write and awaits acknowledgement. Awaited failures do not poison the unrelated pending-write flush.

Mobile and incoming roles synchronously invalidate each other before persistence; getSession and published session lists veto retired topics. Durable retirement records load before SDK session authority; failed/malformed reads fail closed and initialization can retry.

Explicit disconnect and account removal await retirement storage, while relay disconnect failure after a durable tombstone is separately logged. removeSessions inspects every account in base/scoped namespaces, includes retired SDK records for failed-write retry and now handles standalone EVM primary identity.

Pairing claims cancellation immediately, shares the retirement promise, keeps failed known-topic attempts retryable and avoids disconnecting pre-existing/imported sessions. UI close waits for cancellation acknowledgement; failed storage keeps the screen with an error/retry and suppresses late success/navigation.

Compiled Chrome harness calls actual trusted create/remove/disconnect handlers, asserts retirement before acknowledgement, checks two worker restarts and idempotent retries. It explicitly does not inject or prove retained SDK authority/relay negotiation; service tests cover stale SDK records.
limits: No real relay, phone or production WalletConnect negotiation was exercised by this reviewer. New retirement-specific adapter tests use actual BaseExtensionStore with mocked Chrome callbacks; the new BaseWebStore branch is not independently qualified by this review.

Unknown-topic cancellation can only persist retirement after a late approval reveals the topic. No durable denial of a not-yet-known session is claimed. Background delete/expire failures retain runtime veto and log failure; failed storage is not durable retirement until retried/acknowledged.

Committed public address writes may remain after late cancellation; durable tombstone suppresses session authority. Durable public record deletion/current-selection preference and other lifecycle persistence remain separate gates.
Cross-page/web-tab live invalidation, external storage mutation, storage reset/corruption recovery and tombstone compaction are not qualified.
This reviewer read source/tests/harness and recorded findings; parent owns final full-suite/build/Chrome execution and source freeze validation.

Incoming production file is unchanged from base; uncommitted mobile fixes and added tests were present. Before-v1.json pins incoming source and exact test overlay. All eight incoming counterparts reproduce.

Independent review identified omitted primary EVM identity when linked ethereumAddress is absent. Actual service and native account-removal handler reproduce; final source matches primary or linked EVM, and complete final suite includes both regressions.

Intermediate full2829-test and build passes at applicationc7f96e30; superseded by full2831-test and rebuilt artifact after the standalone EVM correction. No browser run was made against the intermediate build.

limits: Real Chrome validates normal persistence callbacks and clean worker reload. Read/write failures, retained stale SDK records and session events are controlled service fixtures; abrupt process termination, physical disk failure and real phone/relay negotiation remain unqualified.

An unknown-topic cancellation cannot persist a topic until late approval reveals it. No durable denial of a not-yet-known session is claimed. Delete/expire event write failures log the failure and retain running veto; failed storage is not durable retirement until successfully retried.

Committed public addresses can remain after late cancellation; a successfully saved retirement suppresses that session authority. Public-record deletion, current-selection preferences, whole-wallet reset and password partial-failure handling remain separate durability gates.

The shared store selects BaseWebStore for web builds, but new retirement-specific validation covers BaseExtensionStore. Browser IndexedDB, cross-tab live invalidation, external storage mutation, journal compaction and corrupt-state recovery remain separate gates.

Pairing screen cancellation behavior is component-tested. No new visual/assistive-technology acceptance or actual phone session is claimed. Historical-upgrade/private-chain matrices, broader screen/authentication work, signed production archives and publication remain open.
